notes.title: v1.0.0 patch notes
notes.content:
[b] Full version is now live [/b]
Bugs fixed:
[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug where the seed couldn't be picked up
    [*] The color blue should now be more blue...
    [*] Health drains more quickly after losing a body part
    [*] Options menu added to the main menu and first level
    [*] Mouse and keyboard controls now work even when there is a controller plugged in already
[/list]

[b] patch 1.0.3 [/b]
[list]
    [*] Quest appearing in menu shouldn't happen anymore
    [*] Fixed a few typo's
[*] Fixed platform cycles to better sync
[/list]

notes.title: Full Release LIVE 🔥
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31450224/78a6c79ac83707a25236261da289abbf8a3940a9.png[/img]

Aurora Trail's full version is now available for play, for free!
We added a lot of new levels. After listening to your feedback we decided to up the difficulty on these levels by a fair margin. 
Believe us, you [u]will[/u] die, a lot, in these new levels.

Enjoy!



[i](we are not responsible for any broken hardware that was thrown out of the window during a playsession of this game)[/i]

notes.title: Download issues resolved
notes.content:
Some of you noted that our page had no download button visible.
We contacted Steam and resolved this issue.

If you were not able to download the game previously, then now is your chance!

Happy trailing!
